title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 11B: Music and places to hear it
subtitle: Kinds of music, people who play music and places to hear it

words.def: music from the past, played by an orchestra, for example by Mozart
words.sent: Mozart wrote ___ music for orchestras.

words.def: music with a strong beat where musicians often make up the tune as they play
words.sent: The saxophone player in the club was playing ___.

words.def: a play in which the actors sing all the words, with an orchestra
words.sent: Alana went to the ___ with her dad at the National Concert Hall.

words.def: loud music played with electric guitars and drums
words.sent: The band had electric guitars and drums and played very loud ___ music.

words.def: popular modern music with a simple tune, often on the radio
words.sent: She’s a very famous ___ singer — her songs are always on the radio.

words.def: traditional music of a country or an area, often played on guitars and violins
words.sent: In Óbuda you can listen to Hungarian ___ music while you eat.

words.def: fast music with a strong beat that people dance to in a club
words.sent: People danced all night to fast ___ music in the club.

words.def: music from many different countries and cultures
words.sent: The festival has pop, jazz and ___ music from many countries.

words.def: music played by musicians in front of you, not a recording
words.sent: They serve food and often have ___ music in the evenings.

words.def: a big group of musicians who play classical music together
words.sent: Top ___ from all over the world play at the National Concert Hall.

words.def: a person who plays a musical instrument, often as a job
words.sent: The ___ played the guitar in the street.

words.def: a small group of people who play rock or pop music together
words.sent: They had a really good ___ at Szimpla Kert last week.

words.def: a person who plays recorded music at a club or on the radio
words.sent: The ___ played records all night at the club.

words.def: a person who sings songs
words.sent: The ___ has an amazing voice.

words.def: a famous singer or musician in a rock band
words.sent: You can see your favourite ___ close up at the Sziget Festival.

words.def: a large building where you go to hear an orchestra
words.sent: The National Concert Hall has a theatre and a museum as well as a ___.

words.def: a place where you go to dance, listen to music and meet people at night
words.sent: We danced in a ___ until two in the morning.

words.def: a place where concerts and live music happen
words.sent: The A38 Ship is a famous ___ in Budapest.

words.def: a building where you go to see plays
words.sent: We saw the play Macbeth at the City ___.

words.def: an event, often outdoors, with many bands or singers over a few days
words.sent: Every August the Sziget ___ takes place on an island in the river.
